prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic two-image editorial diptych with an ancient mythological goddess aesthetic, set around Roman bath or temple ruins during a soft natural golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with a serene authoritative expression in the first panel and a quiet mysterious expression in the second. Give her a wet-look hairstyle and a gold snake armlet with a Cleopatra or Medusa-inspired visual character. Do not reproduce Sydney Sweeney or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Panel 1 is a medium portrait of the adult woman kneeling in water with a serene authoritative expression, wearing a rose-pink silky ancient-chiton-inspired dress and the gold snake armlet. Include three large Corinthian columns, a clear blue sky, and their reflections in the water. Panel 2 is a full-length side-angle composition with her leaning against a large stone pedestal and her feet immersed in water; show the full figure and surrounding stones, wet-look hair and realistic water droplets. Include the upper entablature of the columns, gentle ripples, ancient earthen walls and stone. Keep the two panels consistent in identity, wardrobe, jewelry, ruins and water setting.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use soft natural golden-hour light with warm gold highlights, serene ancient grandeur and subtle mystery. Use a palette of mauve, gold, sky blue and stone gray, with realistic water reflections and gentle ripples.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic two-panel editorial diptych, medium portrait plus full-length side angle, natural perspective, realistic silky fabric, wet hair, stone and water texture, golden-hour daylight, clean high-detail composition, no text or watermark.
